expect_red: a proposed anchor is a hollow marker BESIDE the node's anchor -- never for a node already anchored at a joint or a binding, and never moving the anchor

mutations.contract: A node already anchored at a solver joint or a binding gets no hollow marker: it has its answer, and a proposal beside it would read as a disagreement.
mutations.note: The mutation draws a marker for every proposed node, joint and bound ones included.
mutations.find: if (!a || a.source === AA.MODEL_ANCHOR_SOURCES[0] || a.source === AA.MODEL_ANCHOR_SOURCES[1]) return;
